body: Contributor pre-check: the remote head is 66c3adce3a2a98218792bc6f156dd6909ccd87ad. The PR merges cleanly with main. The final quick gate passes the touched test binary. The body names the pin, separate mutation failures, strict clippy result, and excluded light lane. The diff contains only one test and its decision record. Independent review is still pending.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 66c3adce3a2a98218792bc6f156dd6909ccd87ad -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings.

The full diff adds one test and its decision record. It meets issue #2341.
The test checks added planar blend arcs at both depths, helix entries, finite chained motion, and unchanged solid plunge sites and depths.
Each solid plunge must have a diagnostic that names its XY site and Z level.

Results ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-4083`. No GitHub runner was used.
The base was upstream/main `034e91b8b78fa64989d18e1d5d17344531c4762c`.
Main was already an ancestor of the PR head. The local trial merge retains the PR tree.
Its first parent is the reviewed head. Its second parent is the base above.
The law check used that base's AGENTS.md.

Checks:
- Quick gate: PASS. `adaptive_entry_pieces`: 6 passed, 0 failed. This includes the new test.
- `cargo clippy -j 3 -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- Light lane: PASS. All 11 tests passed across all five test steps: motion lib, adaptive_troch_island, adaptive_troch_neck, adaptive_troch_parallel, and app pocket_pass_start.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: PASS. The worktree has no source changes.

The light command was `cargo xtask gate light --only 'motion light:' --only 'app light:'`.
It selected every light test step. Each step built its target in release mode.
The general release prebuild was interrupted and replaced with these target builds. No pass is claimed for the interrupted command.
The initial tooling build also stalled with the inherited sccache server. It was interrupted.
All completed checks used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=`. The gates also used `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1` and three jobs.

Extra suites run:
- `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 0 failed, 4 existing heavy tests ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `golden_cl`: 34 passed, 0 failed.

The extra suites ran with `cargo test -j 3 -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog --test example_catalog_adaptive --test example_catalog_edge_work --test golden_cl -- --test-threads=3`.

Mutations: not rerun. This PR changes no production G-code, geometry, collision, gouge, or stock simulation code. The safety-tier condition does not apply.
The author's two mutation results remain author evidence, not independent results from this review.
Goldens moved: none. No fixture, importer, dependency, process, or UI file changes. No extra importer suites or screenshots are required.
Full heavy lanes and physical-machine checks were not run. These software results do not certify machine safety.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
